```{r reprocess}
                  rownames(t.cells), value = TRUE)
```

```{r deg_ctcl_tcells_volcano}
deg_all <- FindMarkers(
  t.cells,
  ident.1         = "CTCL",

  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct         = 0.01,
  test.use        = "wilcox",

)

deg_all$gene <- rownames(deg_all)
saveRDS(deg_all, "results/deg_all.rds")
write.csv(deg_all, "results/deg_all.csv")
```

```{r}
#t.cells <- NormalizeData(t.cells)
#Idents(t.cells) <- t.cells$celltype.malig

deg.per.sample.all <- lapply(
  split(colnames(t.cells), t.cells$orig.merge),
  function(cells) {
    sub <- t.cells[, cells]
    ct <- table(sub$celltype.malig)
    if (!all(c("CTCL", "T_Cells") %in% names(ct)) || any(ct < 3)) return(NULL)
    FindMarkers(sub, ident.1 = "CTCL", ident.2 = "T_Cells",
                logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.05, verbose = FALSE)
  }
)
deg.per.sample.all <- Filter(Negate(is.null), deg.per.sample.all)

deg.per.sample.all <- lapply(deg.per.sample.all, function(df) {
  df$dif <- df$pct.1 - df$pct.2
  df
})

saveRDS(deg.per.sample.all, "results/deg.per.sample.all.rds")
```


```{r gene_sig_frequency}
deg.per.sample.all <- readRDS("results/deg.per.sample.all.rds")
gene_sig_counts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(deg.per.sample.all), function(sid) {
  res <- deg.per.sample.all[[sid]]
  keep <- res$p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(res$avg_log2FC) > 0.5
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    gene      = rownames(res)[keep],
    direction = ifelse(res$avg_log2FC[keep] > 0, "Up", "Down")
  )
}))

gene_sig_summary <- gene_sig_counts %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_up    = sum(direction == "Up"),
    n_down  = sum(direction == "Down"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(gene = reorder(gene, n_up - n_down))

gene_sig_long <- gene_sig_summary %>%
  select(gene, n_up, n_down) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(n_up, n_down), names_to = "direction", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(
    y_val     = ifelse(direction == "n_up", count, -count),
    direction = ifelse(direction == "n_up", "Up", "Down")
  )

ggplot(gene_sig_long, aes(x = gene, y = y_val, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = "firebrick", "Down" = "steelblue"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Genes", y = "Samples significant") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
ggsave("figs/deg_up_down_count.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 4.2, dpi = 600)
```

```{r cells_vs_degs}
deg_summary <- deg_summary %>%
  mutate(
    balance_dev = abs(CTCL / n_cells - 0.5),
    log10_CTCL  = log10(CTCL + 1)
  )

cor_cells   <- cor.test(deg_summary$log10_CTCL,  deg_summary$n_sig, method = "spearman")
cor_balance <- cor.test(deg_summary$balance_dev, deg_summary$n_sig, method = "spearman")

ggplot(deg_summary, aes(x = log10_CTCL, y = n_sig)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = balance_dev), size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "grey80", high = "firebrick", name = "Imbalance\n|f - 0.5|") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5,
           label = sprintf("Spearman r = %.2f, p = %.2g", cor_cells$estimate, cor_cells$p.value)) +
  labs(x = "log10(CTCL cells + 1)", y = "Significant DEGs (FDR < 0.05)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
ggsave("figs/deg_cell_count_ndeg_fraction.pdf", height = 4, width = 5)

ggplot(deg_summary, aes(x = balance_dev, y = n_sig)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = log10_CTCL), size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "grey80", high = "steelblue", name = "log10\nCTCL cells") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5,
           label = sprintf("Spearman r = %.2f, p = %.2g", cor_balance$estimate, cor_balance$p.value)) +
  labs(x = "Composition imbalance |CTCL fraction - 0.5|", y = "Significant DEGs (FDR < 0.05)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

# joint linear model
lm_fit <- lm(n_sig ~ log10_CTCL + balance_dev, data = deg_summary)
summary(lm_fit)
```

```{r lfc_shrinkage}
library(ashr)

shrunk_list <- lapply(names(deg.per.sample.all), function(sid) {
  res <- deg.per.sample.all[[sid]]
  # derive SE from p-value and logFC via z-score
  # floor p at double.xmin: underflowed p_val==0 -> z=Inf -> se=0 makes ash
  # shrink the strongest hits to exactly 0; the floor keeps se positive
  p_floor <- pmax(res$p_val, .Machine$double.xmin)
  z  <- qnorm(p_floor / 2, lower.tail = FALSE) * sign(res$avg_log2FC)
  se <- abs(res$avg_log2FC / (z + 1e-10))
  ash_res <- ash(res$avg_log2FC, se, mixcompdist = "normal")
  setNames(ash_res$result$PosteriorMean, rownames(res))
})
names(shrunk_list) <- names(deg.per.sample.all)

# union gene set, build genes x samples matrix
all_genes  <- unique(unlist(lapply(shrunk_list, names)))
shrunk_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(shrunk_list, function(v) v[all_genes]))
rownames(shrunk_mat) <- all_genes
colnames(shrunk_mat) <- names(shrunk_list)

shrunk_mat[1:5, 1:5]
dim(shrunk_mat)

# mask non-significant values (FDR >= 0.05) with NA
sig_mask <- do.call(cbind, lapply(names(deg.per.sample.all), function(sid) {
  res <- deg.per.sample.all[[sid]]
  v   <- setNames(res$p_val_adj, rownames(res))
  v[all_genes] < 0.05
}))
rownames(sig_mask) <- all_genes
colnames(sig_mask) <- names(deg.per.sample.all)

shrunk_mat_sig <- shrunk_mat
shrunk_mat_sig[!sig_mask] <- NA

saveRDS(shrunk_mat_sig, "results/shrunk_mat_sig.rds")
```

```{r heatmap_reproducible}
shrunk_mat_sig <- readRDS("results/shrunk_mat_sig.rds")
min_samples <- 16

tcr_bcr_pattern <- "^TR[ABGD][VDJ]|^TR[ABGD]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IG[HKL][GACME][0-9]?$|^IGK C|^IGLC"

n_sig_per_gene <- rowSums(!is.na(shrunk_mat_sig))
mat_plot <- shrunk_mat_sig[n_sig_per_gene >= min_samples, ]
mat_plot <- mat_plot[!grepl(tcr_bcr_pattern, rownames(mat_plot)), ]
mat_plot <- mat_plot[order(rowSums(mat_plot, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE), ]

cap <- quantile(abs(mat_plot), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

sample_meta <- as.data.frame(t.cells@meta.data) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  distinct(orig.merge, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(orig.merge, Tissue) %>%
  column_to_rownames("orig.merge")

anno_col <- data.frame(
  Tissue    = sample_meta[colnames(mat_plot), "Tissue"],
  row.names = colnames(mat_plot)
)
anno_col$Tissue
anno_colors <- list(Tissue = c("blood" = "#E15759", "lymph node" = "#59A14F", "skin" = "#4E79A7"))

# cluster within each tissue group, then concatenate in order
mat_plot_clust <- mat_plot
mat_plot_clust[is.na(mat_plot_clust)] <- 0
tissue_levels <- c("blood", "lymph node", "skin")
col_order <- unlist(lapply(tissue_levels, function(tis) {
  samps <- rownames(anno_col)[anno_col$Tissue == tis]
  samps <- samps[!is.na(samps)]
  if (length(samps) <= 1) return(samps)
  samps[hclust(dist(t(mat_plot_clust[, samps, drop = FALSE])))$order]
}))
mat_plot <- mat_plot[, col_order]
anno_col <- anno_col[col_order, , drop = FALSE]

# genes to call out on the heatmap
genes_to_label <- c("CD7", "TOX", "KIR3DL2", "NKG7", "CD8A", "HACD1", "LMNA", "HLA-DRB1", "SELL")
genes_to_label <- intersect(genes_to_label, rownames(mat_plot))

label_idx <- match(genes_to_label, rownames(mat_plot))

col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  seq(-cap, cap, length.out = 7),
  rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdYlBu"))
)

row_labels <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
  mark = ComplexHeatmap::anno_mark(
    at     = label_idx,
    labels = genes_to_label,
    labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    link_width = grid::unit(4, "mm")
  )
)

col_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Tissue = anno_col$Tissue,
  col    = anno_colors,
  annotation_legend_param = list(Tissue = list(title = "Tissue")),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  mat_plot,
  col                  = col_fun,
  na_col               = "grey90",
  cluster_rows         = FALSE,
  cluster_columns      = FALSE,
  show_row_names       = FALSE,
  show_column_names    = FALSE,
  show_heatmap_legend  = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Shrunk log2FC"),
  top_annotation       = col_anno,
  right_annotation     = row_labels
)

pdf("figs/heatmap_labeled.pdf", height = 6, width = 6)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```


```{r top_bottom_genes}
gene_stats <- data.frame(
  gene    = rownames(mat_plot),
  row_sum = rowSums(mat_plot, na.rm = TRUE),
  avg_lfc = rowMeans(mat_plot, na.rm = TRUE)
)

top_bottom <- bind_rows(
  slice_max(gene_stats, row_sum, n = 10),
  slice_min(gene_stats, row_sum, n = 10)
) %>%
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(avg_lfc > 0, "Up", "Down"),
    gene      = reorder(gene, row_sum)
  )

lfc_cap <- max(abs(top_bottom$avg_lfc))

plot_gene_bar <- function(df) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = gene, y = row_sum, fill = avg_lfc)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lfc_cap, lfc_cap),
                         name = "Mean shrunk\nlog2FC") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Sum of shrunk log2FC") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11)
}

top10 <- top_bottom %>% filter(avg_lfc > 0)
bot10 <- top_bottom %>% filter(avg_lfc < 0)

p_top <- plot_gene_bar(top10)
p_bot <- plot_gene_bar(bot10)

p_top
p_bot

ggsave("figs/top10_genes.pdf",    p_top, height = 2.7, width = 4.8)
ggsave("figs/bottom10_genes.pdf", p_bot, height = 2.7, width = 4.8)

write.csv(gene_stats, "results/gene_stats.csv")
```


```{r signal_consistency}
n_up_mat  <- shrunk_mat_sig > 0
n_dn_mat  <- shrunk_mat_sig < 0

gene_summary <- data.frame(
  gene        = rownames(shrunk_mat_sig),
  meta_lfc    = rowMeans(shrunk_mat_sig, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_sig       = rowSums(!is.na(shrunk_mat_sig)),
  n_up        = rowSums(n_up_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_down      = rowSums(n_dn_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  mutate(concordance = ifelse(meta_lfc > 0,
                              n_up  / n_sig,
                             -n_down / n_sig)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(meta_lfc)))

head(gene_summary, 20)

lfc_lim_sig <- quantile(abs(gene_summary$meta_lfc), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

conc_df <- gene_summary %>% filter(n_sig > 0)

# among genes sig in >= 50 samples: top 10 up + top 10 down by |meta_lfc|, plus top 10 by n_sig
conc_eligible <- conc_df %>% filter(n_sig >= 50)

label_genes <- conc_eligible %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(meta_lfc > 0, "up", "down")) %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  slice_max(abs(meta_lfc), n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  bind_rows(conc_eligible %>% slice_max(n_sig, n = 10)) %>%
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

p_concordance <- ggplot(conc_df, aes(x = meta_lfc, y = n_sig, color = meta_lfc)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_genes,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low      = "steelblue",
    mid      = "grey80",
    high     = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits   = c(-lfc_lim_sig, lfc_lim_sig),
    oob      = scales::squish,
    name     = "log2FC"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Mean shrunk log2FC", y = "Samples significant") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

p_concordance
ggsave("figs/gene_concordance.pdf", p_concordance, height = 3.5, width = 6)

write.csv(gene_summary, "results/gene_summary.csv")
```


```{r gene_variability}
# variation of shrunk log2FC across samples per gene (non-NA only)
min_samples_var <- 10   # require at least this many significant samples to estimate variance

tcr_bcr_pattern <- "^TR[ABGD][VDJ]|^TR[ABGD]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IG[HKL][GACME][0-9]?$|^IGK C|^IGLC"

gene_variability <- data.frame(
  gene     = rownames(shrunk_mat_sig),
  n_sig    = rowSums(!is.na(shrunk_mat_sig)),
  mean_lfc = rowMeans(shrunk_mat_sig, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_lfc   = apply(shrunk_mat_sig, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
  var_lfc  = apply(shrunk_mat_sig, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  filter(n_sig >= min_samples_var,
         !grepl(tcr_bcr_pattern, gene)) %>%
  arrange(desc(sd_lfc))

head(gene_variability, 20)

write.csv(gene_variability, "results/gene_variability.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# violin plot of per-sample shrunk log2FC for the top most-variable genes
n_top_var <- 16
top_var_genes <- head(gene_variability$gene, n_top_var)

var_long <- shrunk_mat_sig[top_var_genes, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "lfc") %>%
  filter(!is.na(lfc)) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = top_var_genes))

ggplot(var_long, aes(x = gene, y = lfc)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey85", color = NA, scale = "width") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Shrunk log2FC per sample") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r fgsea}
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)

# rank by meta_lfc weighted by reproducibility: log2(n_sig + 1) penalizes single-sample hits
ranks <- gene_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(meta_lfc)) %>%
  mutate(score = meta_lfc * log2(n_sig + 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(score)) %>%
  { setNames(.$score, .$gene) }

# Hallmark + KEGG + Reactome + GO BP
gsets <- bind_rows(
  msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H"),
  msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2"),
  msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5")
) %>%
  split(x = .$gene_symbol, f = .$gs_name)

set.seed(42)
fgsea_res <- fgsea(pathways = gsets, stats = ranks,
                   nPermSimple = 10000, nproc = 16) %>%
  arrange(pval) %>%
  mutate(pathway = gsub("HALLMARK_", "", pathway))

# top 10 up and top 10 down by NES
top_paths <- bind_rows(
  fgsea_res %>% filter(padj < 0.05, NES > 0) %>% slice_max(NES, n = 10),
  fgsea_res %>% filter(padj < 0.05, NES < 0) %>% slice_min(NES, n = 10)
)

top_paths <- top_paths %>%
  mutate(pathway = stringr::str_wrap(gsub("_", " ", pathway), width = 40))

ggplot(top_paths, aes(x = NES, y = reorder(pathway, NES), fill = NES > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("p=%0.3f", padj),
                x = ifelse(NES > 0, 0.05, -0.05)),
            hjust = ifelse(top_paths$NES > 0, 0, 1), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "firebrick", "FALSE" = "steelblue"),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "NES", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r sample_umap}
library(uwot)

# impute NAs with 0 for dimensionality reduction
shrunk_mat_imputed <- shrunk_mat
shrunk_mat_imputed[is.na(shrunk_mat_imputed)] <- 0

# PCA then UMAP on samples (transpose: samples as rows)
pca_res <- prcomp(t(shrunk_mat_imputed), scale. = TRUE, rank. = 30)

set.seed(42)
umap_res <- umap(pca_res$x, n_neighbors = 10, min_dist = 0.3, metric = "cosine")

# deviation from mean profile as outlier score
mean_profile  <- rowMeans(shrunk_mat_imputed)
sample_dev    <- colMeans((shrunk_mat_imputed - mean_profile)^2)

umap_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP1      = umap_res[, 1],
  UMAP2      = umap_res[, 2],
  orig.merge = colnames(shrunk_mat),
  deviation  = sample_dev
) %>%
  left_join(
    as.data.frame(t.cells.ss@meta.data) %>%
      rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
      distinct(orig.merge, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      select(orig.merge, Sample.Type.simple, Dx),
    by = "orig.merge"
  )

ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = deviation, size = deviation), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "grey80", high = "firebrick", name = "Deviation") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5), guide = "none") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = umap_df %>% slice_max(deviation, n = 10),
    aes(label = orig.merge), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Sample.Type.simple) +
  labs(x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r transcriptional_diversity}
# compute per-cell Shannon entropy and mean pairwise cosine distance
# for CTCL and T_Cells separately within each sample
diversity_df <- do.call(rbind, parallel::mclapply(names(deg.per.sample.all), function(sid) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("CTCL", "T_Cells"), function(ct) {
    cells <- colnames(t.cells)[t.cells$orig.merge == sid &
                                 t.cells$celltype.malig == ct]
    if (length(cells) < 5) return(NULL)
    mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(t.cells[, cells], layer = "data"))

    # Shannon entropy per cell
    entropy <- mean(apply(mat, 2, function(x) {
      p <- x / (sum(x) + 1e-10)
      -sum(p * log(p + 1e-10))
    }))

    # mean pairwise cosine distance (subsample for speed)
    cells_sub <- if (ncol(mat) > 100) sample(ncol(mat), 100) else seq_len(ncol(mat))
    mat_sub   <- t(mat[, cells_sub])
    norms     <- sqrt(rowSums(mat_sub^2)) + 1e-10
    mat_norm  <- mat_sub / norms
    cos_sim   <- mat_norm %*% t(mat_norm)
    mean_dist <- mean(1 - cos_sim[upper.tri(cos_sim)])

    data.frame(orig.merge = sid, celltype.malig = ct,
               entropy = entropy, mean_cos_dist = mean_dist)
  }))
}, mc.cores = 16))

# paired plot: entropy
ggplot(diversity_df, aes(x = celltype.malig, y = entropy,
                         fill = celltype.malig)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_line(aes(group = orig.merge), color = "grey60", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(color = celltype.malig), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("CTCL" = "firebrick", "T_Cells" = "steelblue"),
                    guide   = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CTCL" = "firebrick", "T_Cells" = "steelblue"),
                     guide  = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean Shannon entropy") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

# paired plot: pairwise cosine distance
ggplot(diversity_df, aes(x = celltype.malig, y = mean_cos_dist,
                         fill = celltype.malig)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = TRUE) +
  geom_line(aes(group = orig.merge), color = "grey60", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(color = celltype.malig), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("CTCL" = "firebrick", "T_Cells" = "steelblue"),
                    guide   = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CTCL" = "firebrick", "T_Cells" = "steelblue"),
                     guide  = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean pairwise cosine distance") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r nfeature_comparison}
meta_df <- as.data.frame(t.cells@meta.data) %>%
  filter(celltype.malig %in% c("CTCL", "T_Cells")) %>%
  mutate(celltype.malig = factor(celltype.malig, levels = c("T_Cells", "CTCL")))

# paired per-sample means
per_sample_feat <- meta_df %>%
  group_by(orig.merge, celltype.malig) %>%
  summarise(mean_nFeature = mean(nFeature_RNA),
            mean_nCount   = mean(nCount_RNA),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = celltype.malig,
              values_from = c(mean_nFeature, mean_nCount)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_nFeature_CTCL) & !is.na(mean_nFeature_T_Cells))

# paired wilcoxon on nFeature
wt_feat <- wilcox.test(per_sample_feat$mean_nFeature_CTCL,
                       per_sample_feat$mean_nFeature_T_Cells,
                       paired = TRUE)
cat("nFeature paired Wilcoxon p =", wt_feat$p.value, "\n")

# paired violin: nFeature
feat_long <- per_sample_feat %>%
  select(orig.merge, mean_nFeature_CTCL, mean_nFeature_T_Cells) %>%
  pivot_longer(-orig.merge, names_to = "group", values_to = "mean_nFeature") %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(group == "mean_nFeature_CTCL", "CTCL", "T_Cells"),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("T_Cells", "CTCL")))

p1 <- ggplot(feat_long, aes(x = group, y = mean_nFeature, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = TRUE) +

  geom_point(aes(color = group), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("CTCL" = "firebrick", "T_Cells" = "steelblue"), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CTCL" = "firebrick", "T_Cells" = "steelblue"), guide = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(feat_long$mean_nFeature),
           label = sprintf("p = %.3g", wt_feat$p.value), size = 3.5) +

# nFeature vs nCount to check confounding
```

```{r nfeature_gam}
library(mgcv)

meta_df$log10_nCount  <- log10(meta_df$nCount_RNA)
meta_df$orig.merge_fac <- factor(meta_df$orig.merge)

# mixed-effects GAM: smooth depth + fixed celltype + random sample
gam_fit <- bam(
  nFeature_RNA ~ s(log10_nCount, k = 10) +
                 celltype.malig +
                 s(orig.merge_fac, bs = "re"),
  data   = meta_df,
  method = "fREML",
  discrete = TRUE
)

summary(gam_fit)

# plot with GAM smooth per group
p3 <- ggplot(meta_df, aes(x = log10_nCount, y = nFeature_RNA, color = celltype.malig)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 10), se = TRUE, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CTCL" = "firebrick", "T_Cells" = "steelblue"),
                     name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "log10(nCount_RNA)", y = "nFeature_RNA",
       caption = sprintf("GAM celltype.malig p = %.3g",
                         summary(gam_fit)$p.table["celltype.maligCTCL", "Pr(>|t|)"])) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

p3
```

```{r gsea_per_sample}
# run fgsea on each sample's DEG ranked by avg_log2FC
gsea_per_sample <- parallel::mclapply(names(deg.per.sample.all), function(sid) {
  res <- deg.per.sample.all[[sid]]
  ranks_s <- setNames(res$avg_log2FC, rownames(res))
  ranks_s <- sort(ranks_s, decreasing = TRUE)
  ranks_s <- ranks_s[!duplicated(names(ranks_s))]

  tryCatch({
    fgsea(pathways = gsets, stats = ranks_s,
          nPermSimple = 1000, nproc = 1) %>%
      select(pathway, NES, padj) %>%
      mutate(sample = sid)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}, mc.cores = 16)
names(gsea_per_sample) <- names(deg.per.sample.all)
gsea_per_sample <- Filter(Negate(is.null), gsea_per_sample)

# NES matrix: pathways x samples
all_paths <- unique(unlist(lapply(gsea_per_sample, `[[`, "pathway")))

nes_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(gsea_per_sample, function(df) {
  v <- setNames(df$NES, df$pathway)
  v[all_paths]
}))
rownames(nes_mat) <- all_paths
colnames(nes_mat) <- names(gsea_per_sample)

# sig mask: NA where padj >= 0.05
sig_nes_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(gsea_per_sample, function(df) {
  v_nes  <- setNames(df$NES,  df$pathway)
  v_padj <- setNames(df$padj, df$pathway)
  ifelse(v_padj[all_paths] < 0.05, v_nes[all_paths], NA)
}))
rownames(sig_nes_mat) <- all_paths
colnames(sig_nes_mat) <- names(gsea_per_sample)

cat("Pathways x samples:", nrow(nes_mat), "x", ncol(nes_mat), "\n")
cat("Pathways significant in >= 1 sample:",
    sum(rowSums(!is.na(sig_nes_mat)) >= 1), "\n")
```

```{r gsea_plots}
# pathway-level summary
path_summary <- data.frame(
  pathway     = rownames(sig_nes_mat),
  meta_nes    = rowMeans(sig_nes_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_sig       = rowSums(!is.na(sig_nes_mat)),
  concordance = rowMeans(sign(sig_nes_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  filter(n_sig >= 1, !is.na(meta_nes)) %>%
  mutate(score = meta_nes * log2(n_sig + 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(score)))

# scatter: n_sig vs meta_nes colored by concordance
ggplot(path_summary, aes(x = meta_nes, y = n_sig, color = concordance)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "grey80", high = "firebrick",
                        midpoint = 0, name = "Concordance") +
  labs(x = "Meta NES", y = "Samples significant") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

# heatmap of top reproducible pathways
min_path_samples <- 5

path_keep <- path_summary %>%
  filter(n_sig >= min_path_samples) %>%
  pull(pathway)

mat_path <- sig_nes_mat[path_keep, ]
mat_path[is.na(mat_path)] <- 0
mat_path <- mat_path[order(rowSums(mat_path), decreasing = T), ]

cap_nes  <- quantile(abs(mat_path), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
col_nes  <- colorRamp2(c(-cap_nes, 0, cap_nes), c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))

# top/bottom pathway labels
path_scores  <- rowSums(mat_path)

Heatmap(
  mat_path,
  name              = "NES",
  col               = col_nes,
  top_annotation    = col_anno,
  show_row_names    = F,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_columns   = TRUE,
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 6)
)
```


```{r dif_aggregate_test}
# aggregate per-sample dif (pct.1 - pct.2) values across all samples, by gene
deg.per.sample.all <- readRDS("results/deg.per.sample.all.rds")

dif_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(deg.per.sample.all), function(sid) {
  res <- deg.per.sample.all[[sid]]
  data.frame(
    orig.merge = sid,
    gene       = rownames(res),
    dif        = res$dif,
    sig        = res$p_val_adj < 0.05,
    row.names  = NULL
  )
}))

dif_summary <- dif_long %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    sum_dif  = sum(dif),                        # total sum of dif across samples
    n_sig    = sum(sig),                        # number of samples gene is significant
    mean_dif = mean(dif),                       # mean dif per sample (all samples gene appears in)
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig))

dif_summary
```
